# Smithsonian Institution Archives

> > The official archives documenting the history, governance, collections, and exhibitions of the Smithsonian Institution and its museums.

The Smithsonian Institution Archives preserves and provides access to records, photographs, and historical documentation spanning the founding of the Smithsonian by James Smithson through its development into the world's largest museum and research complex. The archives include institutional records, historical photographs, exhibition documentation, and biographical materials related to key figures like Joseph Henry and the Board of Regents.

## Key Topics

- Smithsonian Institution
- Museum history
- Historic photographs
- Exhibition documentation

- Joseph Henry

## Institutional History & Governance

- [Smithsonian Institution Board of Regents](https://siarchives.si.edu/history/smithsonian-institution-board-regents): Board of Regents governance history and institutional oversight info
- [Jun 5 Smithson Estate Is Transferred to US Agent Richard Rush](https://siarchives.si.edu/history/this-day-smithsonian-history/june-5): 1838 transfer of James Smithson estate to US agent Richard Rush
- [Apr 19 SI Unveils Joseph Henry Statue on the National Mall](https://siarchives.si.edu/history/this-day-smithsonian-history/april-19): 1883 dedication of Joseph Henry statue on National Mall by Congress
- [Installation of I. Michael Heyman - siris_sic_10220](https://siarchives.si.edu/collections/siris_sic_10220): 1994 installation ceremony of Secretary I. Michael Heyman at Castle

## Exhibition History

- [Apr 18 Ceremonies Commemorate Opening of Adams-Clement Collection](https://siarchives.si.edu/history/this-day-smithsonian-history/april-18): 1951 Adams-Clement Collection opening ceremony at Arts & Industries
- [Thomas Edison Exhibit Opens](https://siarchives.si.edu/history/this-day-smithsonian-history/october-9): 1979 Edison exhibit opening at National Museum of American History
- [Apr 5 "Golden Age of Flight" Opens at NASM](https://siarchives.si.edu/history/this-day-smithsonian-history/april-5): 1984 Golden Age of Flight exhibit opening at Air and Space Museum
- [May 30 NMNH Opens New "Mammals in the Limelight" Exhibit](https://siarchives.si.edu/history/this-day-smithsonian-history/may-30): 1985 opening of Mammals in the Limelight exhibit at Natural History
- ["How Things Fly" Exhibit Opens at Air & Space Museum](https://siarchives.si.edu/history/this-day-smithsonian-history/september-20): 1996 opening of hands-on How Things Fly exhibit at Air & Space Museum
- [Room of Plexiglass Exhibit at Cooper-Hewitt Museum - siris_sic_9132](https://siarchives.si.edu/collections/siris_sic_9132): 1976 plexiglass exhibit at Cooper-Hewitt Museum opening at Carnegie

## Archival Collections & Digital Preservation

- [The Warren Robbins Papers](https://siarchives.si.edu/blog/warren-robbins-papers): Warren Robbins papers acquisition for African Art Museum founder
- [Three Cheers for Embedded Metadata](https://siarchives.si.edu/blog/three-cheers-embedded-metadata): Digital preservation benefits of embedded metadata in photo archiving

## This Day in Smithsonian History

- [SI Displays Aircraft in South Yard Building](https://siarchives.si.edu/history/this-day-smithsonian-history/october-7): 1920 WWI aircraft display in South Yard Building on Smithsonian grounds
- [Apr 8 Commission of Fine Arts Approves Junzo Yoshimura's Quad Design](https://siarchives.si.edu/history/this-day-smithsonian-history/april-8): 1980 approval of Yoshimura's Quadrangle building design by Fine Arts
- [New Restaurant Opens at NASM](https://siarchives.si.edu/history/this-day-smithsonian-history/september-17): 1988 opening of Wright Place restaurant at Air and Space Museum
